dilithium_ref.prehash_api: crypto_sign_signature_internal / crypto_sign_verify_internal with pre = 0x01||len(ctx)||ctx||OID (FIPS 204 Alg. 4/5, section 6 testing interface)

cryptography_crosscheck.name: pyca/cryptography
cryptography_crosscheck.prehash_api: none native; sign_mu/verify_mu take a caller-computed mu

cases.title: liboqs exposes no HashML-DSA algorithm or prehash API
cases.detail: get_enabled_sig_mechanisms() lists no HashML-DSA name; Signature has no prehash method (only is_extmu=False).

cases.title: liboqs sign with 256-byte context fails
cases.detail: sign_with_ctx_str(msg, 256-byte ctx) raises RuntimeError 'Can not sign message with context string'.

cases.title: liboqs verify with 256-byte context returns False
cases.detail: verify_with_ctx_str(msg, sig, 256-byte ctx, pk) returns False (no exception); FIPS 204 Alg. 3 requires an error indication, and a boolean False is the binding's equivalent of it.

cases.title: cryptography sign with 256-byte context fails
cases.detail: ValueError 'Context must be at most 255 bytes'.

cases.title: cryptography exposes no native HashML-DSA API (only external-mu sign_mu/verify_mu)
cases.detail: sign_mu/verify_mu take a caller-computed mu; the caller must build M' per FIPS 204 Alg. 4/5 itself.
